_comment: Single source of truth for which nixpkgs stable release the darwin and
release lanes track. scan.yml derives the channel URL and the branch ref
from `stable`; scripts/check-channel-pin.py fails the daily run when this
pin falls behind nixpkgs. Bump `stable` here and nowhere else.
`stale_after_days` is the age at which a pinned channel that has stopped
advancing is treated as EOL. nixpkgs-<stable>-darwin normally republishes
every few days; 25.11-darwin froze on 2026-07-02 and went unnoticed for 42.
